description: CUR-BULK (F: deletion discovered before GetRows), variant: the cursor sits ON a row that another call deletes. (a) dynaset on T at ID 3: ID 3 is deleted through the Database, the ID read (deleted slot), GetRows(3), the state, GetRows(3) again; (b) a new dynaset on Move 2 (ID 4): IDs 4 and 5 are deleted, GetRows(2), the state; (c) table-type on T at its third row: that row is deleted, GetRows(2), the state.
retentionNote: Designed r-q2-cursor-dao probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
